# Company Offer Research

Target: Local
Kind: on-demand
Repo path: workflows/company-offer-research/index.ts

## Purpose

Research the main offers of companies in an input list.

## Inputs and outputs

Reads a company CSV and saves a local report with one result or failure per company.

## Operation

For each company, find its website, visit it, summarize the top offers, continue after unreachable websites, save all results locally, and show the report.

async function researchCompany(company: Company) { const website = await findWebsite(company); const page = await retry(() => fetchWebsite(website), 3); return summarizeOffers(page, { model: 'saved-default' }); }
async function run(rows: Company[]) { const results = []; for (const row of rows) { try { results.push(await researchCompany(row)); } catch (error) { results.push({ company: row.name, status: 'failed', error: String(error) }); } } await stateDb.save(results); await writeReport(results); }
